title: ast.search response
description: Tagged `result` union. On `ok`, `matches` carries every query match with its bounding `range` and a `captures` map keyed by bare capture name (no leading `@`). `invalid_query` and `unsupported_language` report the failure and carry an empty `matches`.

language.description: Resolved grammar name on `ok`; null on the error variants.

match_count.description: Number of matches in `matches` (after any `max_matches` truncation).

truncated.description: True when `max_matches` dropped additional matches beyond those returned.

had_errors.description: True when the parsed tree contained ERROR/MISSING nodes. Search still runs against the partial tree; the caller decides whether to trust the results.

query.description: Echo of the offending query on `invalid_query`.

details.description: Human-readable explanation on the error variants.

error_row.description: 0-based row of the query error on `invalid_query`.

error_column.description: 0-based column of the query error on `invalid_query`.

fallback_suggestion.description: Text-level fallback to reach for on `unsupported_language`.

text.description: Source slice spanning the match's bounding range.

captures.description: Map from bare capture name to its bound text and range.
